meta.title: 1000 English Chunks for Vietnamese Learners
meta.description: English chunks with Vietnamese meanings, grammar patterns, examples, usage notes and starter spaced-repetition state.
meta.level_note: CEFR levels are approximate learning suggestions, not official ratings.
meta.content_note: The first 100 entries are standalone high-frequency chunks. The remaining entries are pattern-based combinations with topic vocabulary; proofread context and naturalness before public release.
